notes: Adds an Open Vault Records button to the Hub while the 30-minute Vault session is active. It opens a read-only, searchable view of the records already authorized in the current TEE session, so iPhone users do not have to navigate through Safari, Source Documents, or Maintenance to confirm records such as Emilio and Robert. No Vault records, passphrases, Adaptive Checklist data, or trip information are changed.
name: TEE v3.4.80 — Hub Vault Records
